case.summary: Case HHG-010 was opened following a risk score of 0.90 on transaction 3506725 for $1,000.03 on card C10434-K1. The transaction was flagged as suspicious because it was 7.6x the card's average purchase amount and conducted via a new device. Following R1, the initial action was to verify with the customer since the assessed fraud probability was only 0.04. The customer confirmed the transaction and the new device, so the final action was to allow the transaction and close the case.
